items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: I had a friend of mine by the name of Wilbur Sweatman

ctx.x: Did they ever use banjos when you were down here much?

No, guitar. Only after I left here, when banjos got popular, I think around 1917 or 18, because all the bands up north were using banjos. Did they use tubas in the band? And I had a friend of mine by the name of Wilbur Sweatman, I guess you heard that. He wrote the Down Home Rag. Where...
This is not that master, it's a different one. This is the Bluebird I got here.
